# Saburi Plywood
# https://www.saburiply.com

Saburi Plywood is a leading Indian manufacturer of premium plywood, blockboard,
flush doors, WPC/PVC boards, MDF, and laminates. Known for quality, innovation,
and sustainable manufacturing practices. Products are ISI certified, manufactured in
Kolkata, and available across India through an extensive dealer network.

Certifications: FSC, CARB Compliant, CE Certified, ISO 9001:2015, IGBC Certified.
Headquarters: Kolkata, West Bengal.
Presence: West Bengal, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka (Bangalore).
